name: instructor
note: Needs API keys: its suite is marked 'integration: may require API keys', its conftest calls load_dotenv(), and thirteen test modules read OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

label_rule.reason: On a machine with no keys the LLM tests cannot execute, and the provider integration modules for SDKs that are not installed do not import, so there is no honest execution trace to characterize against.
